exposure: Duration of the interval between menarche and the first birth
outcome: Risk of operative delivery (emergency cesarean or assisted vaginal delivery)
cohort: 38,069 eligible women (first labors at term with a singleton infant in a cephalic presentation) from the Norwegian Mothers and Child Cohort Study
finding: Later menarche was associated with a reduced risk of operative delivery, but this association was lost after adjusting for the menarche to birth interval, suggesting that the duration of exposure of the uterus to hormones may influence the risk of operative delivery.
